title: feat(studio): open Studio's dashboards and reports in the app's edit state; × returns to the list
body:
Fixes #36906

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio 的仪表盘、报表列表里点一项会直接进入应用里的编辑状态（仪表盘进编辑态、报表打开构建器），页头的 × 回到刚才的 Studio 列表（刷新后也在），报表列表的「新建」进入应用的新建报表页。
- 属于 Studio 重构专题：Studio 是某个应用的开发界面，这一步打通了 Studio 和应用之间的往返编辑。
- 从 Studio 报表列表新建的报表改由应用的新建报表页保存，和以前一样存进该包（已安装的应用存进它的定制包），只有保存那一刻定制包恰好用不了时才存到包外并提示列表里看不到它；出错会影响打开到哪里和新报表存在哪里，可以直接撤回，已存的报表留在原处，只有草稿的仪表盘和报表、以及已安装应用定制包里的仪表盘和报表暂时仍打开 Studio 原来的详情页。
- 无。

## What changes

Epic #36890, decisions 3, 6, 13 and 15.

- **Studio opens a dashboard or a report in its app.** A plain open of a dashboard or a report in Studio's list no longer shows the generic item page. It opens the item's page in an app, using the arrival state the design mode already uses: the dashboard opens in its edit state, the report opens its builder. The Studio address is replaced, not stacked, so browser Back from the app lands on the list.
- **Which app (decision 6).** It is the app the author came from, when that app is one of the package's published apps, or when its menu opens the item. Otherwise it is the package's first published app. With no app, the item keeps the generic item page (decision 3). The same happens on the cross-package leg, and whenever the address asks the item page for one of its own tools (a tab, the draft review, a selection), so History and the draft door's review links still land there. The rule is shared with Studio's back link (`studioBackTarget`), so the two cannot disagree. It lives in a new pure module, `studioAppEdit.ts`, and the area's step is `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx`.
- **× back to Studio (decision 15).** The app address carries `?studio=` with the Studio list it came from, filters and sort included. It is built and read only through `studioAddress.ts` (`withStudioReturn`, `readStudioReturn`) and registered as a reserved console param. The value is read as untrusted: only a Studio address on this origin is followed. While the param is present, the dashboard page and the report page draw a × that returns to that list, after a reload too. The report builder's own × does the same. Leaving unsaved edits asks first.
- **Report New (decision 13).** Studio's report list New opens `/apps/APP/reports/new` in the app picked the same way. Its × goes back to the list, and the saved report's page keeps the way back. With no app, the area creates as before. Dashboard New is #36907's, untouched.
- **Where that new report is saved.** Opened from Studio, the new-report page saves the report into the app's package, the way a new view made in an app is saved (`resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`): the package when it is writable, else its `.custom` pair through the ensure door; when neither can be had, naming no package, as views fall back, and then an info notice says the report was saved outside the app's package, so the Studio list does not show it (`report.builder.savedOutsideApp`, the counterpart of a view's `onSavedOutsideApp` notice). The draft, the publish and the discard of a refused publish all name that package (`saveAndPublishInPackage`), so on every other leg the report is in the list × returns to. The console warning `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` prints on that fallback now names the type it saves (it said "the view" for a report too): the function takes the type as its second argument. On a read-only base whose pair door is closed (walled, or a kernel package), report New no longer opens the app page: it goes back to the list, as every create there does.
- **An item with no published version keeps the generic item page.** Before handing over, `StudioAreaAppOpen` reads the item once, as the app reads it (published, no draft preview, `?package=` the open package). No published version (a draft only: an AI draft, a create whose publish was refused), or a failed read, keeps Studio's generic item page, which is the page that opens the draft. Only then are the package's apps read.
- **A dashboard made in Studio lands in its app, and Back skips the create page.** The area's own create publishes and lands on the item, which the gate forwards to the app. In a package's area, for a dashboard or a report, that landing now replaces the create page's history entry (`studioCreateLandsInApp`, read by `ResourceEditPage`), so Back from the app lands on the list. Every other type, and Setup, land as before.
- **The report builder's × and the new-report page's × ask over unsaved edits outside Studio too.** Both handlers already received `dirty` for the Studio leg; the ask now runs before either leg.
- **No dashboard edit on a phone.** `useDashboardEditOffered` now also requires a window at least `sm` (640 px) wide, the width from which the edit state's side panel is drawn. Before, only the button's CSS hid it. A landing that asks for the edit state on a narrower window is cleared and opens nothing, so neither Studio nor the design mode can put a phone into the edit state.
- New `studioReturn` strings, and `report.builder.savedOutsideApp`, in every bundled locale (additive only; no released key removed). zh-Hant is regenerated from zh-Hans by its generator.

## Why

The maintainer asked that dashboards and reports listed in Studio open straight into the front end's design page (epic #36890). The epic's decisions fix which app, the fallback, the report New target and the address-borne way back.

## Tests

- New `studioAppEdit.test.ts`: decision 6, rule by rule; the new-report variant; agreement with the back link; the app addresses.
- `studioAddress.test.ts`, new top-level describe: the `?studio=` builder and reader, the refusals both ways (another origin, protocol-relative, `/studiox`, a backslash, `javascript:`), and the reserved-param registry.
- New `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx`, through the real `StudioMetadataArea` routes: the app picked, the arrival carried, the return address (list context kept, item-only params dropped), the replace, and every open that keeps the item page (a tab, the review, no app, the cross-package leg, other types). Also report New, and its fallback.
- `DashboardView.inPageEdit-36372.test.tsx`, new describe: landing from Studio, × target, × after a reload, the dirty prompt, the phone landing (cleared, no edit, no Edit button), and an off-Studio value drawing no ×.
- `ReportView.designModeExclusion-36692.test.tsx`, new describe: landing in the builder, the builder × to Studio, its dirty prompt, the page × beside Edit, and the card's check: reached with the design mode already on, no builder and no Edit, while × still goes back.
- `ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx`, new describe: × to Studio, and Save keeping `?studio=`. This round: Save from Studio names `packageId: P` on the draft and the publish; on a read-only base it names the pair (`P.custom`, asked of the ensure door); CONTROL: a refusing ensure door falls back to the package-less save. × over an edit asks; declining stays with nothing sent; agreeing goes back to the Studio list (and the clean × asks nothing). Outside Studio: Save names no package and asks no package door, and × over an edit asks.
- `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx`, previous round: a draft-only dashboard row keeps the item page and reads no app; so does a draft-only report and a failed read; `studioCreateLandsInApp` rule by rule. Its "dashboard create → Save lands on the app's dashboard and Back lands on the list" case drives the area's routes over a create STUB (`CreateStub` reimplements the landing), so it pins the gate's forward and Back over a replaced entry, not `ResourceEditPage`'s call site; that is pinned in the new file below. A read-only base (`readOnly`, `customization` handed in): its dashboard row opens in the base's app; a pair-row address (`/studio/BASE.custom/metadata/dashboard/X?package=BASE.custom`) keeps the generic page (the starting point of #37237); report New opens the base app's new-report page; with the pair door walled, or no customization, report New goes back to the list.
- `ReportView.designModeExclusion-36692.test.tsx`, previous round: outside Studio, a clean builder × closes without asking; over an edit it asks, declining keeps the builder, agreeing closes it.
- New `ResourceEditPage.createLandingReplace-36906.test.tsx` (this round), the REAL `MetadataResourceEditPage` over a real `MetadataClient` and an in-memory server: under a `MetadataAreaHost` with a `packageId`, a dashboard create's Save lands on the item with a REPLACE (`useNavigationType`); CONTROLs: a `view` create in the same area, and a dashboard create with no area host (Setup), land with a PUSH. Each case also pins the save's `?package=` (the area's package, or none).
- `ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx`, this round: the refusing-door CONTROL now also asserts the info notice (once, the `report.builder.savedOutsideApp` key) and that the console warning names the report; the package, pair and outside-Studio cases assert no notice. The clock is gone from the save cases: the Han romanizer `handleSave` awaits is paid once in a `beforeAll` (a cold dynamic import, paid at collection), and every save case waits on the address it asserts (`waitFor`) instead of two `setTimeout(0)` ticks, so a late save can no longer land in the next case.
- Ablation (one, on the behaviour change the tests pin): with the phone gate removed from `useDashboardEditOffered`, the phone pin fails 1/1. Restored, its blob equals HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- This round's ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), are listed under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Read first, by risk (rework 2):** the notice line after the save in `ReportNewPage.tsx` (fires only when Studio opened the page, the app has a package, and none could be had), and the new real-page pin `ResourceEditPage.createLandingReplace-36906.test.tsx`.
- **Read first, by risk (rework 1):** the save hunk of `ReportNewPage.tsx` (where a report made from Studio is written: the package, its pair, or none), the published-version read at the top of `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx`'s effect, and the `replace` on the create landing in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (shared by every type; it reads `studioCreateLandsInApp`, true only for a dashboard or report in a package's area).
- **Read first, by risk (first round):** `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx` (async app pick and replace; the fallback), the `useDashboardEditOffered` and arrival hunks in `DashboardInPageEditor.tsx` and `DashboardView.tsx` (the phone gate now also governs the design mode's landing), and the `?studio=` reader in `studioAddress.ts` (an address-bar value followed by a navigate).
- `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` is kept narrow: one import, the item open wrapped in `StudioAreaAppGate`, and the create split. Open PRs #37089, #37168 and #37169 edit the same file in other hunks. `overlap-check` merges cleanly with all three at this head. Whichever lands later merges main.
- **Callers of the persistence path.** `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` changes in one place this round: `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage(appPackageId, type, doors?)` takes the type it resolves for, only so its fallback warning names it; its answer is unchanged, and its two internal callers pass the type they save (`view`). The new-report page now also calls two of its existing exports: `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` (other callers: `createRuntimeMetadata` and `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` themselves, for views only) and `saveAndPublishInPackage` (other callers: `saveInPlace`, the in-page dashboard and report Save, and `setup/publicForms.ts`). `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`'s other callers (`objectViewViewSharing.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `setup/publicForms.ts`) and `createRuntimeMetadata`'s (`objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `ObjectDataPage.tsx`) are untouched.
- **Outside Studio, a new report is saved where it was before.** The new-report page reached from the app's own reports index still saves naming no package, and asks no package door (pinned). Only the page opened from Studio's report list resolves a package.
- **Draft-only check (M2): one read, not the list row's mark.** The read covers every way into the item address: a list click, a typed or shared address, and the area's create landing on the item. The list row's draft mark would cover the click only. The read is asked as the app asks it, so the two cannot disagree.
- **A pending Studio draft over a published version.** The item has a published version, so it opens in the app, which shows the published version. A dashboard's edit state then refuses to open, with the existing toast 「This dashboard has unpublished changes in Studio. Publish or discard them there, then edit it here.」, so the page stays a viewer. A report's page shows the published version, and its builder opens on the pending draft's content (the report's Edit reads the stored draft layer first, `authoredBuffer`); the builder's Save is then refused with 「This report has unpublished changes. Publish or discard them above, then save.」, and nothing is written over the draft (the first-write pin). Either way the draft stays Studio's to publish or discard. Read from the code at this head, not walked.
- Reload (seat ruling: keep as shipped): after a reload, × back to the Studio list survives, but the editor does not reopen. A reloaded or shared address never opens an editor by itself; that is the arrival modules' rule.
- Card item 5 (a dashboard saved on an installed app lands in `.custom`) is pinned at unit level by the existing case "an installed package saves into its customization pair". It is NOT MEASURED live on HotCRM: no HotCRM checkout is in this session. That leg carries to #36910.
- Follow-up card filed: #37237. In this PR, a `.custom` pair's dashboards and reports keep the generic item page (decision 6, rule 3); #37237 resolves them through the base package's apps.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open Studio for a writable package with a published app, go to Reports, press New, pick a data source and a measure, name it, and Save. Expected: the report's page in the app, with a 「Back to Studio」 ×; click it, and the new report is in the Studio list.

Rework 2's readings are at head `298361bd` (this branch with `origin/main` `057cedfa` merged in) unless a line names another head. The previous rounds' readings below keep their own heads (`08107d2f`, `727300e5`).
